prompt:
Production Unity sprite animation sheet for Spitter. Reference defines exact enemy identity, silhouette and perspective. Create redrawn articulated action frames of this same creature. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray-white sinew, subtle amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style. Fixed elevated 45deg game view, soft upper-left lighting. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
EVERY frame faces: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-left, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-left. Never front-left. No camera or body angle changes during abilities/death. Rear views keep rear feet closest to viewer.
Grid EXACTLY FOUR columns and 6 rows; 24 complete separate bodies. PORTRAIT canvas width-to-height 4:6. Each creature fits middle 60% of its cell; generous transparent gutters so no neighboring toes/armor touch. Same body scale and ground anchor throughout. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Draw genuine distinct joint motion; do not copy identical stills or merely rotate/scale. Maintain anatomy and plate layout. Full transparent alpha0 background, including between legs. No opaque brown backdrop, no ground/shadow, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
